proposals.reason: Native-parent-attested inline episode source cannot be repaired by the existing script/route profiles.
proposals.recommendation: Generate a Brain-owned reusable catalogue-inline-token source family, not a provider-specific patch. Build typed evidence -> source parsing -> bounded token resolution -> terminal media validation; require compilation, exact rematerialized bytes, official NuvioTV correct episode/audio and sibling non-regression. No mutation authority from independent CI.

blueprint.causalTrigger: The V1 reader-matrix parser is installed and replayed, but the provider still returns zero streams. Exact-parent independent diagnostics observed opaque lien identifiers plus epsJeton and one same-origin resolver response with HTTP 200, JSON object, URL field and HTTPS output. This is diagnostic source evidence only.
blueprint.method: Generate a reusable typed opaque-token resolver profile. Preserve lien identifiers during episode selection, extract the source-owned token without evaluating scripts, resolve only the same-origin /api/lien.php contract, accept only an HTTPS URL field, then hand it to existing trusted media extraction. Never persist token/id/response URL.
requiredEvidence: installed and revalidated reader-matrix V1 parser
exact current provider bytes plus official Android TV zero-extraction parent
acceptanceProof: typed Brain resolver program compiled and wired into all Repair selection gates
candidate bytes actually differ, compile, rematerialize and replay
official NuvioTV decodes the correct requested episode with audio
compatible sibling non-regression before family fanout

proposals.reason: 1 provider(s) exhausted every bounded Core Repair experiment variant and were explicitly deferred for a new strategy.
proposals.recommendation: Synthesize one or more new bounded repair/evidence strategies from the common failure cohorts and independent Lab observations. Do not recycle the exhausted bounded g2..g5 family or increase retry counts. Each new strategy must have an explicit causal trigger, negative-memory signature, playback/identity acceptance proof and regression test before it may re-enter Core Repair.
